rv.q: Like Monet's, this musical's ambition sometimes comes at a cost, but it still lands in a place of beauty and deep feeling.
There are some big themes covered in this musical and it is a credit to Owen that they are handled with confidence and at times with great skill.

It’s disheartening to see Theatre put something on like this...there’s an immense amount of talent in London, and there’s most certainly a brilliant script out there in need of a stage. This is sadly not it.
